surfaceNotes: US English; country-level location 2840; cities specified in the query; desktop/Windows.
ChatGPT and Gemini collected with DataForSEO LLM Scraper, not direct model APIs; ChatGPT force_web_search enabled.
AI Overviews collected from Google organic AI Overview items with asynchronous loading; AI Mode collected from its separate Google endpoint.
Same-day sequential waves. Provider-side caching, signed-in personalization and physical city IP were not controlled.
A missing AI answer is not evidence that a dental practice was absent from an answer.

qualitativeReviewNotes: The denominator is this fixed 36-slot source-page follow-up, not all 216 planned core responses or all dental websites.
True means positive evidence on the inspected page, not independently verified credentials, availability, prices or clinical quality.
False means no positive evidence found on the inspected static page only; it is not evidence of whole-site omission.
Null means not inspectable or no selected page. Inaccessible, navigation, booking, no-answer and collection-failure states are kept separate.
Treatment and named-dentist evidence uses substantive page content; location/contact evidence may also use the inspected footer or contact links.
Dentist evidence requires authored clinician information, excluding navigation-only names and patient-testimonial names alone. Dental contact evidence excludes directory-publisher support contacts.
Price qualification evidence means visible fees, payment/insurance/financing context or a relevant price limitation, not a verified treatment quote.
Private HTML/text snapshots are retained locally by SHA-256 and are not redistributed in the public dataset.
qualitativeReviewMethod: Assistant inspection of saved static page text and contact links, with explicit per-page scope; regex contexts are private review aids, not the final feature decisions. No human or clinical review is claimed.
